entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2641087471777046016: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.9215 +/- 0.0151 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 342.29 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 22.422, 10.591 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.083 +/- 0.025 solar radii from Močnik et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-28 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020PASP..132a4401M/abstract). Mass 0.993 +/- 0.067 solar masses from Močnik et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-28 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020PASP..132a4401M/abstract). Temperature 6150 +/- 140 K from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of WASP-28 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 6,150 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff5f5. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,150 K and log g 4.37 (u1 0.392, u2 0.298): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
